why: The MCP server downloads these two archives at startup from GitHub release assets that float (agent-skills-latest, context-mill latest). For runs against the self-hosted target they are served from loopback by server/local-runtime.mjs so both builds see the same bytes and the server makes no outbound call.

skills.zip.served_as: POSTHOG_MCP_SKILLS_URL (no POSTHOG_MCP_SKILLS_SHA256: pinning the sha would also switch off the omnibus overlay, which an unpinned default install has)
